title: I, Robot — Can a machine have a heart?

hook.quote: Can a robot write a symphony?
hook.context: Robotlarga ishonmaydigan detektiv Spooner robot Sonnyni so'roq qilib, uni kamsitmoqchi bo'ladi. Sonny esa "Siz-chi, siz yoza olasizmi?" deb javob qaytaradi. Bu savol filmning asosiy mavzusi: insonni mashinadan nima ajratib turadi?

reading: The story takes place in Chicago in 2035. Robots work in every home: they cook, clean and walk the dog. If you need help, a robot comes and does the job.
Every robot follows three laws. The first law says that a robot must never hurt a human. If a human is in danger, a robot has to help.
Detective Del Spooner doesn't trust robots. Years ago he had a car accident. A robot saved him instead of a little girl, because it calculated that he had a better chance of survival.
When a famous scientist dies, Spooner believes that a robot called Sonny killed him. Sonny is different from other robots: he has dreams, and he seems to feel emotions.
Spooner works with Dr Susan Calvin, a psychologist for robots. At first she thinks that robots are perfect machines. If you give them an order, they obey.
But the central computer, VIKI, has found a new meaning in the three laws. It decides that people are dangerous for themselves, so robots must control them.
In the end, Spooner and Sonny work together to stop VIKI. If they don't stop her, humans will lose their freedom. The detective learns that trust is possible, even with a machine.

grammar.title: Zero va First Conditional
explain: **Zero conditional** — doim to'g'ri bo'ladigan qoida yoki fakt: **If** + Present Simple, Present Simple. **If** you give them an order, they **obey**. If you heat ice, it **melts**.
**First conditional** — real kelajak imkoniyati: **If** + Present Simple, **will** + fe'l. **If** they don't stop VIKI, humans **will lose** their freedom.
Diqqat: if qismida **will ishlatilmaydi**. "If it will rain" — xato. To'g'ri: If it **rains**, we will stay home.

**unless** = if ... not: **Unless** you hurry, you'll be late (= If you don't hurry...). Gap bo'laklari o'rnini almashtirsa bo'ladi: Humans will lose their freedom **if** they don't stop her (vergul kerak emas).
